translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 9.10.2019 (radio)
There are shortcomings in the work of many children's homes. External pressures increase parents' exhaustion. Snus imports have decreased. Turkey is adding troops to the Syrian border.
## Problems in children's homes
![child welfare, small group home, Kuusankoski](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_479/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-5920055d81f6b61cf6f/1568798459)
Open image viewer
In the hallway, things are put back in their places. Photo: Terhi Liimu / Yle
There are shortcomings in the work of many children's homes.

Yle's study found that regional administrative agencies and the Parliamentary Ombudsman have intervened in the work of more than 50 child welfare institutions in recent years. This means that about 10% of child welfare institutions have been operating with shortcomings.
Until now, problems have been talked about in the media in only a few children's homes. According to Yle's investigation, there are shortcomings in many child welfare institutions.
For example, the Child Welfare Act has been broken, children's rights have been violated, or things have not been recorded as they should be.
## Parents' exhaustion was studied
![A child and a mother holding hands](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10903053)
Open image viewer
Young parents get exhausted more easily than slightly older parents. Photo: Jussi Mansikka / Yle
External pressures increase parents' exhaustion. In Finland, researchers have studied for the first time why parents of small children become exhausted, that is, tired out.

Often, what causes a father's or mother's exhaustion is the feeling about what others think of whether they can look after their children. Exhaustion can be caused if the family has little money, or if the child needs special support.
Young fathers and mothers get exhausted more easily than older fathers and mothers. An expert says that child health clinics can support parents, so that parents can cope.
## Snus imports decreased
![Snus can](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6016,h_3384,x_0,y_320/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-7481358932c10e3bca/1517250112)
Open image viewer
Snus pouches in a snus tin. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
The import of tobacco from trips abroad has increased slightly.
During the year, Finns brought about 370 million tobacco products from abroad, that is 3% more than the year before.

Tobacco products also include snus. Snus is tobacco that is held in the mouth and sucked. Snus imports have decreased. 16 million tins of snus were brought to Finland from trips, that is 13% fewer than a year ago.
## Turkey attacks Syria
![A Turkish army tank driving towards the Syrian border near the town of Akçakale on 8 October.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11011305)
Open image viewer
A Turkish army tank drives towards the Syrian border near the town of Akçakale. Photo: Bulent Kilic / AFP
Turkey is adding troops to the Syrian border. Turkey has moved armoured vehicles and other heavy equipment to the Syrian border. Turkey says that it will attack north-eastern Syria.
US President Donald Trump has decided to pull US troops out of the area, so that Turkey can attack Syria. Kurds living in the USA held a demonstration in front of the White House on Tuesday.
Turkey has a large army and many weapons. A Finnish expert estimates that it will be difficult for the Kurds to resist the Turkish attack.
